literal_meaning: ঝাঁকি দেওয়া বা খোঁচা দেওয়া (pinching or pricking)
figurative_meaning_en: to annoy or irritate, to repeatedly nag or pester
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আমাকে সারাদিন খুঁচাচ্ছে তার কাজের জন্য।
example_sentences_in_english: He has been nagging me all day about his work.
The child is pestering his mother by pinching to get food.
history: The idiom derives from the literal act of pinching to urge action, often used in contexts like debt recovery as in traditional Bengali rural life.
note: Common in spoken Bengali to express mild frustration from persistent urging.
